concerns.advisory: The `_hydrateEmbedded` regex change from `/(.+)\_id$/` to `/(.+)\_id(s?)$/` applies to every model loaded through the shared REST store, so any existing payload key ending in `_ids` will now be deleted and replaced by a pluralized hydrated array — a global behavior change whose blast radius extends well beyond embedding.
concerns.why: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 `_hydrateEmbedded` now branches on `m[2]` and does `delete obj[k]` unconditionally in the plural branch.

concerns.advisory: The migration hard-codes `force: true` on `create_table :embeddable_hosts`, so re-running or running it on a database that already has the table silently drops it and all its rows.

The migration interpolates the raw `embeddable_hosts` site-setting value directly into an INSERT string with no quoting/escaping, so a host containing a single quote (or any SQL metacharacter) breaks or alters the migration.

The migration inserts host values via raw SQL, bypassing the model's `before_validation` normalization, so legacy values stored as `http://foo.com` or `example.com/1234` are persisted verbatim and will never match `record_for_host`, silently breaking embedding for those sites after upgrade.
concerns.why: Migration `records.each { |h| execute "INSERT ...('#{h}'...)" }` vs `EmbeddableHost` `before_validation` that strips scheme and path.

concerns.advisory: The migration derives the default category by joining `site_settings.value` to `categories.name` and immediately indexes `[0]['id']`, which assumes a row exists; sites with no `embed_category` setting or a renamed category get a nil-dereference during deploy.

The migration deletes the `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` site-setting rows, so during a rolling deploy any old app process still calling `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` (also removed from the model) loses its host allowlist and rejects embeds.
concerns.why: Migration's `DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')` combined with removal of `allows_embeddable_host?` from app/models/site_setting.rb.

concerns.advisory: Removing the public `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` site settings is a breaking API change for plugins, themes, deployment automation, and the site-settings API that read or set them, and there is no deprecation shim.
concerns.why: config/site_settings.yml drops both keys; config/locales/server.en.yml drops both descriptions.

concerns.advisory: `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` runs `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` on every embed request and every topic-retriever check, against a table with no index on `host` and with `lower()` on the column defeating any plain index, so allowlist checks become a full scan on the public embed path.
concerns.why: app/models/embeddable_host.rb `record_for_host`; migration creates no index on `host`.

concerns.advisory: There is no uniqueness validation or unique index on `host`, so the new admin UI happily creates duplicate host rows and `record_for_host` picks an arbitrary one — meaning the effective posting category for a duplicated host is nondeterministic.
concerns.why: app/models/embeddable_host.rb has only `validates_format_of :host`; migration adds no unique index.

concerns.advisory: The two new admin controllers ship with specs that only assert class inheritance — nothing covers create/update/destroy behavior, parameter handling, or that non-staff users are rejected — leaving an untested admin write surface.
concerns.why: spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and embedding_controller_spec.rb each contain a single `is a subclass of AdminController` example.

concerns.advisory: `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` performs no mutation — it re-serializes the same `OpenStruct` — while the client controller exposes a `saveChanges` action calling `embedding.update({})`, so the PUT endpoint and its route are a no-op contract that will mislead future callers.
concerns.why: app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb `update` body is identical to `show`; admin-embedding.js.es6 `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`.

concerns.advisory: `basePath` normalizes the model type with `type.replace('_', '-')`, which replaces only the first underscore, so any admin model name with two or more underscores would not be matched and would be routed to `/` instead of `/admin/`.

`expandable_first_post?` no longer gates on any embeddable-host configuration, so sites with `embed_truncate` enabled and no hosts configured now get expandable first posts where they previously did not — and the surviving spec named "is false if embeddable_host is blank" no longer tests that condition at all.
concerns.why: app/models/topic.rb drops `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? &&`; spec/models/topic_spec.rb keeps the same example name with all setup removed.

concerns.advisory: The category fabricators were moved verbatim into `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` while the embeddable-host fabricator now lives in `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb`, so both files' contents contradict their filenames.
concerns.why: The diff swaps the bodies of spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb and the new spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb.

concerns.advisory: The new admin embedding screen has no JavaScript acceptance test; only the underlying store hydration is covered, leaving the route, controller actions (addHost/deleteHost/saveChanges) and the embeddable-host component untested.
concerns.why: test/javascripts changes touch only create-pretender.js.es6 and models/store-test.js.es6; no acceptance test for `adminEmbedding`.

concerns.advisory: The added `admin.embedding.edit` locale key is never referenced by any new template, leaving dead translation strings for translators to maintain.
concerns.why: config/locales/client.en.yml adds `edit: "edit"` under `embedding:`; templates/components/embeddable-host.hbs uses an icon-only `d-button` for edit.
